paragraphs.text: The proposer acknowledges the submission deadline of September 15, 2023, at 4pm, as stated in the RFP. The proposer has ensured that all necessary inputs will be provided to the bid manager by September 8, 2023, allowing ample time for review and submission preparation.

All inquiries and communications regarding the proposal have been conducted exclusively through the designated email address, bids@syrairport.org, in compliance with the RFP requirements. The proposer has confirmed their contact information with the Authority as instructed.

The proposer is prepared to provide additional information or clarification as requested by the Authority. The engineering lead is available for interviews to address any technical or procedural questions.
